comment: Material plus structure written as one word, exactly the ones 표준국어대사전 lists as a headword (checked one by one; 돌 담 is 돌담). Everything else stays two words: 석재 벽돌 기둥, 조약돌 담, 나무 계단. Left out on purpose: 철벽 (only the figurative 'impregnable defence') and 모래벽 (a plastered wall), which would mislead for a block structure.
